explanation: Zero everywhere except at D2 when the agent chose a2 and landed rarely in S1 late in the episode: about 9-10 from trial ~89 on, about 7 near trial 87, about 3 near trial 82, and 0 before trial ~80 (D1 and GO are always 0, and so are all a1 choices). Within that late window it is highest (9-10) when the D1 of the same trial showed a reward. It drops to about 5 when that D1 showed no reward or the previous trial was also a rare S1 landing, and to about 0-1 when both are true.
